title: Literal signed finite Tate comparison data
statement: Fix the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions] and a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. At predecessor n, the coefficient ring is the finite quotient A=ULift(O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1))). The signed etale powers are the tensor and internal-Hom powers of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], and the pro-etale powers are those of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] with their constant A-action retained. Define pulled sections using the unit of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] followed by arbitrary restrictions. The etale evaluation is the closed-category counit; the pro-etale evaluation applies the local functional on the terminal object of its slice, using [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. SignedSiteEvaluation requires equality of these evaluations on all pulled sections. SignedSiteMultiplication requires the square with the actual ordered products; their normalization is [def-sf-signed-line-product-normalization-data]. SignedSiteGeometric is a family of inverse-image isomorphisms for every scheme map; SignedSiteGeometricLaws requires the root-projection equations of [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent], evaluation, and the canonical identity and composition constraints. SignedSitePullbackSquare uses the comparison mate of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. SignedSiteTheta and SignedSiteThetaNormalized prescribe the projection formula of [def-pur-frame-class]; SignedSiteRootCoefficient is its equation with the same-root map of [lem-amb-finite-root-site-comparison]. These are literal predicates, with no chosen comparison family. The dual conventions are those of [lem-pur-signed-line-derived-base-change].
